answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via time-locked fidelity bonds audited by a randomness beacon. Each agent locks tokens in a non-transferable escrow contract and answers unpredictable challenges issued by the beacon, preventing clones from drifting like a zephyr across a free identity meadow. Every fake identity incurs the verifiable opportunity cost of frozen capital and slashing risk. However, collateral rules favor wealthy attackers and exclude underfunded builders.
